caseName: Neil v. Utah Wholesale Grocery Co.
caseNameFull: J. W. Neil v. Utah Wholesale Grocery Company
attorneys: Mr. William R. Andrews and Mr. Joseph Chez for plaintiff in error. Mr. Jacob Evans and Mr. Mahlon B. Wilson for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
